shellCommands.command: ls 03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/ | grep -i prefetch; echo "--- types:"; grep -rn "partialPrefetching" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts | head

echo "=== prefetch response (App Shell) ===" && curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' http://localhost:3111/product | tr -d '\0' | grep -o -e 'Premium Widget' -e 'Checking availability' -e 'in stock' | sort | uniq -c

curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3111/product?_rsc=HEAvJdHAQJrUAe2K' | tr -d '\0' | grep -o -e 'Premium Widget' -e 'Checking availability' -e 'in stock' | sort | uniq -c

curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' 'http://localhost:3111/product?_rsc=HEAvJdHAQJrUAe2K' -o /tmp/prefetch.bin -w "bytes=%{size_download}\n"; strings /tmp/prefetch.bin | grep -i -o -e 'Premium Widget' -e 'Checking availability' -e 'in stock' | sort | uniq -c

grep -c 'Premium Widget' .next/server/app/product.html; grep -o -e 'Premium Widget' -e 'Checking availability' -e 'in stock' .next/server/app/product.html | sort | uniq -c; echo "=== segments dir:"; ls -la .next/server/app/product.segments/product/ 2>/dev/null | head
pkill -f "next start" ; cd /workspace && git status --short && echo "=== tsconfig diff:" && git diff -- tsconfig.json && cat .gitignore
git status --short; echo "=== tsconfig diff:"; git diff -- tsconfig.json; echo "=== gitignore:"; cat .gitignore
rm -rf .next && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -14; echo "=== tsconfig re-touched?"; git diff --stat -- tsconfig.json
